worldcombat.skill.powersplit.summary: Temporarily averages both bodies’ attack values. Pokémon also share Special Attack; ordinary bodies contribute their attack attribute, including weapons.
worldcombat.skill.powersplit.use.0: Raise your low offense to the foe's level
worldcombat.skill.powersplit.use.1: Drag the foe's high offense down to yours
worldcombat.skill.powersplit.use.2: Close the gap when the foe hits far harder
worldcombat.skill.powersplit.description: Average Attack and Sp. Atk with a target within %1$s blocks, held for %2$s; a clear line is required.
Weapon attack is included for ordinary bodies; ability stages remain separate. This change is removed when the effect ends or is cleared.
worldcombat.skill.powersplit.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP to split, then %3$s seconds to recover and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.powersplit.growth.0: At level %1$s the split reaches %2$s blocks and the window lasts %3$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.powersplit.growth.1: At level %1$s the split reaches %2$s blocks and the window lasts %3$s seconds.
The companion only splits when the threat is within this distance; lower stays close, higher chases the gap down.
The foe's combined raw Attack and Sp. Atk must reach this multiple of yours. Higher is pickier and only splits against a clearly stronger foe; lower casts more often.
On: it leaves its station under a hold order to split. Off: it only casts when the target is already in reach.
